fact_text: The reporter said Pakistan's retail sector is squeezed by transport-led inflation, weaker purchasing power and early closures of offline markets and malls.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Eid 2026: Is Daraz Saving Pakistani Households? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-15)

fact_text: Daraz's managing director said the 2026 retail squeeze is a supply-led crisis rather than a demand-led one, driven mainly by transport-cost inflation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Eid 2026: Is Daraz Saving Pakistani Households? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-15)

fact_text: Daraz plans monthly sales campaigns on dates given as 6 June, 7 July and 8 August 2026, each lasting only a few days.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Eid 2026: Is Daraz Saving Pakistani Households? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-15)

fact_text: Daraz's Everyday Low Price module offers lower prices on frequently bought items by working directly with sellers, according to its managing director.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Eid 2026: Is Daraz Saving Pakistani Households? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-15)

fact_text: Daraz offers brand-exclusive discounts lasting two to four hours and flash sales of about 50 items, which it said drive customers to open its app daily.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Eid 2026: Is Daraz Saving Pakistani Households? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-15)

fact_text: Daraz works with banks and digital wallets to offer extra discounts on purchases, so customers can get a discount on most days.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Eid 2026: Is Daraz Saving Pakistani Households? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-15)

fact_text: Daraz refunds returned orders below a set value, letting customers keep the item and get their money back, to protect the buying experience.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Eid 2026: Is Daraz Saving Pakistani Households? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-15)

fact_text: Daraz removes sellers from its platform, temporarily or permanently, if they repeatedly send fake or wrong products, and requires them to complete courses before returning.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Eid 2026: Is Daraz Saving Pakistani Households? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-15)

fact_text: Daraz offers free shipping on most of its items, using logistics partners so that price-sensitive customers can buy at a low total cost.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Eid 2026: Is Daraz Saving Pakistani Households? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-15)

fact_text: Daraz said it plans to focus on buy-now-pay-later in 2027 through a partner, using its customer data to assess credit risk and offer better rates.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Eid 2026: Is Daraz Saving Pakistani Households? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-15)

fact_text: Daraz measures conversion rates, meaning the share of visitors who buy, when prices change, to see how customers respond to price moves.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Eid 2026: Is Daraz Saving Pakistani Households? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-15)

fact_text: Pakistan's per-capita GDP is not in the thousands of dollars, so e-commerce platforms must offer low prices and free shipping to serve a price-sensitive population.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Eid 2026: Is Daraz Saving Pakistani Households? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-15)

fact_text: E-commerce in Pakistan should keep growing as logistics and payment networks improve and more brands and small sellers come online, though a surge may fade as in the Covid period.
